original.target_description: Experiment 4, agency index for the sexual versus clothed images of the same woman; follow-up LSD comparison.

n.sample_role: Participants in sexual and clothed conditions; target comparison sample size not separately printed.
n.exclusions: One of 67 recruited participants excluded for incomplete questionnaire; remaining sample spans three conditions, so it does not establish the two-condition analytic n.
n.quote: Sixty-seven participants (38 female, M age = 20 years) were recruited as in Study 1. One participant was excluded for failing to complete the questionnaire.

replication.target_description: Replication of Experiment 4 Part 1, Hypothesis 1: agency index in Sexual versus Clothed conditions, independent samples Welch t test, post-exclusion analysis. The supplied locators differ from the pagination/table numbering in the OSF preprint.

n.sample_role: Participants contributing agency index scores to the independent Sexual versus Clothed contrast (335 Sexual; 338 Clothed).
n.exclusions: Main analysis uses the full sample before supplementary exclusions. Naked condition (336 participants) is outside this contrast. Supplementary post-exclusion analysis is separate: 56 exclusions across all conditions; Sexual 321 and Clothed 315.
n.location: Main manuscript p. 42, Table 10 contrast header and note; corroborated by p. 30 Table 9 and p. 31 Hypothesis 1. Supplementary pp. 34, 37–39 distinguish exclusion analysis.
n.quote: Independent samples t-test: Contrast between Sexual Condition (335) and Clothed Condition (338) ... Note. Welch’s t (two-tailed) for independent samples, N = 673.

notes:
Original title and authors verified in author-hosted full paper; source URL https://kurtgray-lab.squarespace.com/s/more-than-a-body.pdf . No printed d or contrast test statistic was found for the original LSD contrast; omnibus F and eta-squared are different tests and were not substituted. Replication title is Revisiting the link between Mind Perception and Objectification: Replication and Extension of Gray et al (2011), by Tsang and Feldman, obtained from assigned OSF file https://osf.io/download/7w5b6/ . Main-text pre-exclusion result (p. 31; Table 10 p. 42): Sexual N = 335, Clothed N = 338, t(666) = -5.20, p < .001, d = -0.40 [-0.56, -0.25]. Post-exclusion values retained consistently for replication n, es and p. Original g = -0.58 in replication comparison table is replication-author-derived and is not a printed effect size in the original target test.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Explicit follow-up LSD comparison of agency in the sexual versus clothed conditions reports p < .05; preserve the printed upper bound.
Completion source review (n_r): Exact target located by agency outcome and Sexual versus Clothed conditions, with supplied Table 9 identifying the main full-sample analysis. Table 10 explicitly prints independent-test N = 673. Participants are the analytic units. Exclusion sensitivity analysis is separate; the primary full-sample model intentionally precedes exclusions. Primary manuscript identity verified through authors, title, exact original DOI and OSF registration/project links.
